import pandas as pd
from fuzzywuzzy import process

file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/da52d699-e8d2-4dc5-9191-a2199e0b6a9b.xlsx"
word_counts = {
    "Fire and Blood": 380000,
    "Song of Solomon": 95000,
    "The Lost Symbol": 165000,
    "2001: A Space Odyssey": 60000,
    "American Gods": 180000,
    "Out of the Silent Planet": 84000,
    "The Andromeda Strain": 70000,
    "Brave New World": 65000,
    "Silence": 46000,
    "The Shining": 155000
}

# Load and add Days
df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
df['Days'] = (df['End Date'] - df['Start Date']).dt.days + 1

# Fuzzy map titles to word_counts keys (low threshold to allow flexibility)
mapped_keys = []
for t in df['Title']:
    match_key, score = process.extractOne(t, list(word_counts.keys()))
    mapped_keys.append((t, match_key, score))

# Create a Word Count column from mapped keys
df['Mapped Key'] = [mk for (_, mk, _) in mapped_keys]
df['Word Count'] = df['Mapped Key'].map(word_counts)

print("Title mapping (original -> matched, score):")
for t, mk, sc in mapped_keys:
    print(f"{t} -> {mk} (score={sc})")

# Compute words per day
df['Words per Day'] = df['Word Count'] / df['Days']
slowest = df.loc[df['Words per Day'].idxmin()]
print("\nSlowest-read book:")
print(f"Book Title: {slowest['Title']}")
print(f"Words per Day: {slowest['Words per Day']:.2f}")

```python
import pandas as pd
from fuzzywuzzy import process

file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/da52d699-e8d2-4dc5-9191-a2199e0b6a9b.xlsx"
word_counts = {
    "Fire and Blood": 380000,
    "Song of Solomon": 95000,
    "The Lost Symbol": 165000,
    "2001: A Space Odyssey": 60000,
    "American Gods": 180000,
    "Out of the Silent Planet": 84000,
    "The Andromeda Strain": 70000,
    "Brave New World": 65000,
    "Silence": 46000,
    "The Shining": 155000
}

df = pd.read_excel(file_path)
df['Days'] = (df['End Date'] - df['Start Date']).dt.days + 1

mapped_keys = []
for t in df['Title']:
    if t in word_counts:
        mapped_keys.append((t, t, 100))
    else:
        mk, sc = process.extractOne(t, list(word_counts.keys()))
        if sc >= 90:
            mapped_keys.append((t, mk, sc))
        else:
            mapped_keys.append((t, mk, sc))  # fallback to fuzzy even if low

# Apply mapping
df['Mapped Key'] = [mk for (_, mk, _) in mapped_keys]
df['Word Count'] = df['Mapped Key'].map(word_counts)

print("Title mapping (tightened):")
for t, mk, sc in mapped_keys:
    print(f"{t} -> {mk} (score={sc})")

# Compute words/day
df['Words per Day'] = df['Word Count'] / df['Days']
slowest = df.loc[df['Words per Day'].idxmin()]
print("\nSlowest-read book:")
print(f"Book Title: {slowest['Title']}")
print(f"Words per Day: {slowest['Words per Day']:.2f}")
```
